name: GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4（TP=4 · Lane A fp8 KV）
description: GLM-5.3-Flash（320B/A18B MoE，glm5_next）NVFP4 量化四节点 TP=4 服务（Lane A — fp8 KV，FlashInfer SM12x unlock）：ACR 烘焙 sm121-v8 镜像（上游 8 层 patch 链）、fp8_e4m3 KV、MTP k=4 投机、1,048,576 上下文、~5M token KV 池、agentic 结构化解码 ~55 tok/s（实测）。
compose_template:
services:
  vllm-glm53:
    image: ${GLM53_IMAGE:-registry.cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/aixn-public/glm53-flash-sm121:v8}
    container_name: ${TASK_NAME}-rank${NODE_RANK}
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python3", "-c", "import urllib.request,sys; sys.exit(0 if urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:${VLLM_PORT:-8000}/health', timeout=5).status == 200 else 1)"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 900s
    pull_policy: if_not_present
    entrypoint: []
    network_mode: host
    ipc: host
    shm_size: "32gb"
    ulimits:
      memlock: -1
      stack: 67108864
      nofile: 1048576
    gpus: all
    devices:
      - /dev/infiniband:/dev/infiniband
    volumes:
      # 生产 launcher 把权重挂在 /cache/huggingface（HF_HOME 指向它）
      - ${HF_CACHE:-${HOME}/.cache/huggingface}:/cache/huggingface
    environment:
      HF_HOME: /cache/huggingface
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: "1"  # 模型由管理平台分发到节点缓存，固定离线加载
      HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET: "${HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET:-1}"
      TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE: "1"
      VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S: "3600"
      # Triton / FlashInfer JIT 编译缓存挂已持久化的 HF 缓存内，容器重建不丢
      TRITON_CACHE_DIR: "${TRITON_CACHE_DIR:-/cache/huggingface/.tritoncache-glm53}"
      FLASHINFER_JIT_CACHE_DIR: "${FLASHINFER_JIT_CACHE_DIR:-/cache/huggingface/.flashinfer-glm53}"
      # SM121 架构 + fp8 KV 所需（源 launcher 全部保留）
      TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "12.1a"
      FLASHINFER_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "12.1a"
      FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK: "1"
      PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF: expandable_segments:True
      VLLM_HOST_IP: "${VLLM_HOST_IP:-}"
      # 网络：RoCE，HCA 由 hca 自动键逗号分隔填充；GID 每启动动态解析
      NCCL_NET: "${NCCL_NET:-IB}"
      NCCL_IB_DISABLE: "0"
      NCCL_IB_HCA: "${NCCL_IB_HCA:-}"
      NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX: "${NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX:-}"
      NCCL_IB_GID_AUTO: "1"
      NCCL_IB_ADDR_FAMILY: AF_INET
      NCCL_IB_ROCE_VERSION_NUM: 2
      NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME:-}"
      GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME:-${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME}}"
      NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE: "0"
      NCCL_CROSS_NIC: "0"
      NCCL_IB_MERGE_NICS: "0"
      NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE: "0"
      NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY: "1"
      NCCL_DEBUG: WARN
      TORCH_NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING: "1"
    command:
      - bash
      - -lc
      - >
        export PATH="/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/bin:$${PATH:-}";
        export CUDA_HOME="$${CUDA_HOME:-/usr/local/cuda}";
        export CUDA_PATH="$${CUDA_PATH:-$${CUDA_HOME}}";
        export CUDAToolkit_ROOT="$${CUDAToolkit_ROOT:-$${CUDA_HOME}}";
        export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/usr/local/cuda/lib64:$${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}";
        exec /usr/local/bin/vllm serve ${GLM53_MODEL_PATH:-LibertAIDAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4}
        --served-model-name ${SERVED_MODEL_NAME:-glm-5.3-flash}
        --host ${VLLM_HOST:-0.0.0.0}
        --port ${VLLM_PORT:-8000}
        --trust-remote-code
        --tensor-parallel-size 4
        --gpu-memory-utilization ${GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION:-0.85}
        --max-model-len ${MAX_MODEL_LEN:-1048576}
        --max-num-seqs ${MAX_NUM_SEQS:-6}
        --block-size 2304
        --moe-backend marlin
        --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":${MTP_NUM_SPECULATIVE_TOKENS:-4}}'
        --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3
        --kv-cache-memory ${KV_CACHE_MEMORY:-25769803776}
        --enforce-eager
        --tool-call-parser glm47
        --enable-auto-tool-choice
        --reasoning-parser glm45
        --default-chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking": false}'
        ${CHAT_TEMPLATE:+--chat-template ${CHAT_TEMPLATE}}
        --distributed-executor-backend mp
        --nnodes ${NODES_TOTAL:-4}
        --node-rank ${NODE_RANK}
        --master-addr ${MASTER_ADDR}
        --master-port ${MASTER_PORT:-29521}
        ${HEADLESS:+--headless}

variables.label: vLLM 镜像
variables.help: 阿里云 ACR 平台镜像：由上游 sm121-v8 构建链（vLLM day-0 glm53-flash-arm64-cu130 + 8 层 patch 栈：SM121 NoPE-MLA FA2、FlashInfer 0.6.18 nightly、NCCL 2.30.7、cutlass-dsl 4.6.2、PDL 关闭、indexer top-k 初始化、fp8 KV smem tile）烘焙并推送
variables.help_en: Aliyun ACR platform image: baked from the upstream sm121-v8 build chain (vLLM day-0 glm53-flash-arm64-cu130 + 8-layer patch stack: SM121 NoPE-MLA FA2, FlashInfer 0.6.18 nightly, NCCL 2.30.7, cutlass-dsl 4.6.2, PDL off, indexer top-k init, fp8 KV smem tile) and pushed

variables.label: 模型路径
variables.help: NVFP4 量化权重（Lane A 主力：LibertAIDAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4，120 分片 ~182GiB）；同为 Lane A drop-in 的 uncensored 版可换 drowzeys/keys-GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4-ablit-l15-45-anchorstock（同 launcher 已验证）；也可填缓存内 snapshot 绝对路径
variables.help_en: NVFP4 quant weights (Lane A main: LibertAIDAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4, 120 shards ~182 GiB); swap in the same-lane uncensored drop-in drowzeys/keys-GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4-ablit-l15-45-anchorstock (verified on the same launcher); or use an absolute snapshot path in the cache

variables.label: 最大上下文长度
variables.help: 模型原生 1M；降低（如 300000）可让多用户端更跟手，须保持 64 对齐
variables.help_en: Model-native 1M; lower it (e.g. 300000) for a snappier multi-user endpoint, keep 64-aligned

variables.label: 最大并发序列数
variables.help: 源 launcher 生产 6（TP4 每 rank ~50GiB 权重，6 个全 262K 会话槽位齐平）
variables.help_en: Upstream launcher production value 6 (TP4 ~50 GiB weights/rank, six full-262K slots)

variables.label: GPU 显存利用率
variables.help: 源 launcher 生产 0.85；与固定 KV_CACHE_MEMORY 搭配，改动请先用真实长 prefill 把关
variables.help_en: Upstream launcher production 0.85; paired with the pinned KV_CACHE_MEMORY — gate any change behind a real long prefill

variables.label: 每节点 KV 缓存预算（字节）
variables.help: 每 rank fp8 KV 预算，源 launcher 现役 24GiB（25769803776）；head-to-head 的 5,033,164 token 池按 32GiB/rank 测得。GB10 上更大的池并发 prefill 会猝死（NVRM OOM）——每次加大必须用真实长 prefill 把关，勿盲升
variables.help_en: Per-rank fp8 KV budget; the upstream launcher ships 24 GiB (25769803776); the 5,033,164-token pool in the head-to-head was measured at 32 GiB/rank. Bigger pools can die under concurrent prefills on GB10 (NVRM OOM) — gate every bump behind a real long prefill

variables.label: MTP 投机 token 数
variables.help: 原生 MTP 投机 k=4；源实测第 4 位近似白嫖，k=3 是可尝试的微调
variables.help_en: Native MTP speculation k=4; position 4 nearly free-rides upstream, k=3 is a candidate micro-tune

variables.label: Chat 模板（含 Vision）
variables.help: 容器内 chat 模板绝对路径；默认空=用 checkpoint 自带 text-only 模板（纯文本可用）。要开 Vision 需把源仓库的 chat_template_mm.jinja 放进节点缓存并填其路径（图片/视频请求无 mm 模板会 500）
variables.help_en: Absolute in-container chat-template path; empty = checkpoint's built-in text-only template (text works). For Vision, place chat_template_mm.jinja from the upstream repo in the node cache and set this to its path (image/video requests 500 without the mm template)

variables.label: Head 节点地址
variables.help: 自动填充 head 节点的 RoCE IP（多节点协调地址，随任务的 head 变化）
variables.help_en: Filled with the head node's RoCE IP (multi-node coordination address, follows per-task head)

variables.label: 节点总数
variables.help: 由任务节点数自动填充（本配方为固定 4 节点拓扑，发布时校验恰好匹配）
variables.help_en: Auto-filled from task node count (fixed 4-node topology; publish validates exact match)

variables.label: Headless（worker 不跑 API server）
variables.help: 自动按角色填充：head 为空、worker 为 1（mp 多节点协调必需）
variables.help_en: Auto-filled per role: empty on head, 1 on workers (required for mp multi-node coordination)

variables.label: 本节点 vLLM 绑定 IP
variables.help: 必须为各节点 RoCE IP，避免分布式绑定错误地址
variables.help_en: Must be each node's RoCE IP to avoid binding the wrong address

variables.label: RoCE HCA
variables.help: hca 自动键按节点返回逗号分隔多 rail（源单 rail：rocep1s0f0）
variables.help_en: The hca auto key returns comma-separated rails per node (upstream single-rail: rocep1s0f0)

variables.label: NCCL 网络接口
variables.help: auto 返回首选 RoCE 口；多 rail 场景可手工覆盖
variables.help_en: auto returns the preferred RoCE interface; override for multi-rail

variables.label: RoCE GID index
variables.help: 每节点/HCA 不同且重启漂移，自动解析（源 launcher 用固定 gid_index=3，本配方按节点动态解析）
variables.help_en: Per-node/per-HCA and drifts across reboots; auto-resolved (upstream hard-codes gid_index=3; this recipe resolves per node)

name_en: GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4 (TP=4 · Lane A fp8 KV)
description_en: 4-node TP=4 serving for GLM-5.3-Flash (320B/A18B MoE, glm5_next) NVFP4 quant — Lane A fp8 KV (FlashInfer SM12x unlock): ACR-baked sm121-v8 image (upstream 8-layer patch chain), fp8_e4m3 KV, MTP k=4 speculation, 1,048,576 context, ~5M-token KV pool, ~55 tok/s agentic structured decode (measured).
